custom_logic_notes: This is a correlation-based hedging/pair trading EA. It opens two simultaneous positions on correlated instruments (e.g. EURUSD and USDCHF). Two auto-direction modes: AutoD (divergent - pairs trade in opposite directions) and AutoM (convergent - pairs trade in same direction). Direction is determined by which currency's session is active based on GMT hour. The EA monitors combined profit of both positions in a Sleep() loop and closes both when combined profit exceeds threshold. SL/TP exits are detected by polling deal history for 'sl'/'tp' comment strings. Day-of-week filter controls which trading days are active. Entry requires both ticket1==0 and ticket2==0 (flat on both symbols). Retry logic with configurable Try count for order submission.
external_dependencies: Correlation (custom indicator .ex5 required - called via iCustom)
python_conversion_notes: Requires implementation of a correlation indicator (Pearson correlation between two symbol price series over Depth bars). The pair-trading hedging logic with simultaneous dual-symbol positions needs a portfolio-level position tracker. The Sleep()-based profit monitoring loop must be replaced with an event-driven or periodic check. SL/TP detection via deal history comments needs translation to position status monitoring. The currency session time-zone direction logic is straightforward to replicate. The dual lot sizes (Lot1/Lot2) and the divergent vs convergent auto modes need careful mapping to the framework's position sizing. Day-of-week filter is simple. The retry loop for order submission maps to order submission with retry decorator.
